chunk_map.heading: How we work in this room

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 "Prework" line 10: "the repo you picked" resolves to the prework's repo choice, named as a navigational pointer, and line 12 "the gap before this module" resolves inside the chunk; chunk 3 line 18 "the bug" resolves to line 16 "a trivial bug" in the same chunk; chunk 10 "Next" line 90 "that session" resolves to "Module 2" in the same sentence and "Your rules file" to WYL line 20. Closest: line 90 "Your rules file gets read at the top of that session", both nouns named. Harm (dangling referent) absent.

Closest: chunk 2 line 10 "the repo you picked" points at a prework choice by name, not by position ("the prework" is named, no locator). Line 12 names Willison's piece by title and author. No 'the opening lecture said' style callback in body (grep for 'opening lecture|earlier lecture|previous module' over body_numbered -> 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw/caught' in body. Closest: line 10 "the repo you picked" refers to the prework's choice, and the maintainer block records the prework hands the repo over. No stranded beat reference.

Every chunk carries a claim. Closest to thin: chunk 4 "How we work in this room" (3 bullets) and chunk 6 "Start here" (a question plus include links); both carry self-standing content (line 24 "Make it work for you..."; line 38 "what's your favourite Claude Code trick..."). Chunk 10 line 90 is two full sentences.

Closest: chunk 8 "Optional challenges" line 64 header vs its four bullets (/loop, routine, PR-comment sweep, rule-compounding automation), all optional side quests; header holds. Chunk 9 "Pre-reads before Module 2" holds four readings. Chunk 7 "Key Concepts" holds six concept bullets.

Closest: line 30 "Not too fast, not too slow." is one balanced pair with no third leg and no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' shape; line 6 "Otherwise you have a clever assistant and no compounding." single declarative. No self-grading superlative (grep 'most useful|best|powerful|game-chang' over body -> 0 relevant hits), no anaphora triple (Read:/Watch: are mode labels), no number-plus-retraction, no verb triplet. Line 40 tail attested by the maintainer's Carded and kept note.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: line 56 "(Oldskool: ccstatusline or `/statusline` runs it live.)" is ordinary engineer register, not repo dialect; 'compounding' and 'rules file' are the training's arc-earned vocabulary. grep 'compendium|forcing function|beat|mood|firing|surface' over body_numbered -> 0 dialect hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 6 "Start here" line 38 carries one bold, "The question, to you:" (4 words, a handle). Chunk 3 WYL five bolded verbs are template-mandated (module-shape.md), N/A per the rule. Chunk 9 pre-reads bold only the mode words (Read:/Watch:), inside the menu waiver and the handle cap. Chunks 4 and 5 (room norms) carry no bold, matching the 2026-09-08 settlement.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` -> 'slides: 10 ... oversized: 0', so the composed set enumerates 10 `##` slides matching the 10 `##` headings in the body; tier markers sit on Key Concepts, Optional challenges, Pre-reads and Next only. Deck slide model verified through the checker, not a browser render.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' grep for below|above|top of over body lines 1-91 -> only line 90 "at the top of that session", which is a session moment, not page position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body links are include-links (lines 39-51 region standalone paragraphs), plain in-body external links with the document named in link text (line 12 "Simon Willison, Vibe engineering"; line 81 "Dex Horthy, Why Software Factories Fail"), no location-by-geometry. Rule is explicitly not a gate and opens no verdict.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` -> 'slides: 10 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets, oversized: 0' ('every slide is within limits'). The maintainer's Slide size accepted note for Pre-reads is not needed by the current text.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 7 line 58 tail "Everyone sees how it will bloat almost immediately." reads as commentary but is kept by the maintainer's Carded and kept (Antti 2026-08-29) note and does work (sets expectation for M6 subtraction). Line 13 "All modules are designed to cope with missing details" is carded-and-kept as the rescue guarantee. The diff since 8b5de788 removed the pre-read tail "The instinct earns itself in use.", an aphorism kicker of class (c), so the slide no longer carries one.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal shape in body; `grep -noiE 'guess|predict|reveal'` -> 2 hits, both at lines 143/179, inside the maintainer's Push-back moves table, below the cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no hand-numbered headers and no `## Phase N:`/`## N.` step headers or in-file 'Phase K'/'Step K' prose anywhere in body. `node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` -> 'OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.'
